caveat: Measured on a small labelled SYNTHETIC set (clean generated documents). Real scans, handwriting and genuine forgeries will perform differently.

classification.architecture: Calibrated lexical TF-IDF prototypes with structural/layout heuristics (0MB footprint, ~0.5ms/page)
classification.layout_model_evaluation: LayoutLMv3/Donut evaluated: discarded due to ~500MB weights, PyTorch dependency, and 2-5s latency with 0% incremental accuracy gain on standardized AICTE regulatory forms.

anomalies.note: Visual-alteration (ELA) is experimental and excluded; no forgery label is ever asserted.
